reducedMotion: remove travel, scale, rotation and shimmer
migration: React SPA owns every document route; same-origin cookies and a pure v1 JSON API replace legacy fragments; Go renders public metadata before boot, React19 owns route metadata after boot; media streams preserve binary/redirect and range semantics

strictStyle.eslint: React Compiler, Hooks, Query and architecture restrictions
strictStyle.stylelint: standard CSS rules with explicit Tailwind4 directives

foundations.owns: Semantic colors, surfaces, type, target sizes, focus, spacing, radii, responsive layouts and reduced motion

primitives.owns: Typed controls, field labels and errors, overlay focus and dismissal, menu and tab keyboard behavior, shared pending and feedback states

mediaCompositions.owns: Media presentation and actions, collection membership, reusable URL entry and stable player actions

formsAndSettings.owns: Confirmation dialogs, shared create/edit playlist form and global/category skipping controls with separate provider policy

application.owns: Navigation and document routes, session gates, URL state, request boundaries, route metadata and announced notifications

dataAndBrowserIntegration.owns: Typed same-origin requests, query keys, shared mutation invalidation, passkey ceremonies and explicit browser lifecycle adapters

screenMap.preserves: Separate sign-in/register ceremonies and validated local return paths

YouTube and podcast discovery, deployment capabilities, RSS entry and source filters

transportBoundaries.callbackSemantics: State-bound browser redirect completion remains separate from v1 JSON commands

resolvedDuplication.result: Owned native-prop primitives provide accessible labels, refs, state and keyboard behavior

migrationResult.documents: React owns all mounted document routes; Go retains public metadata and serves the SPA host
migrationResult.dormantAdmin: Unregistered placeholder removed with the retired document handlers; no admin screen is exposed
migrationResult.runtime: React adapters explicitly mount/dispose each engine; cached immutable snapshots bridge media state; per-mount pagehide/pageshow handles document exit and bfcache intent without background autoplay
migrationResult.preservedGeneration: OpenAPI TypeScript types and SQLBoiler database models remain supported build/development tools
migrationResult.storybook: Shared compiler transform and providers; authored stories stay under web; static Storybook output stays outside Go embedded assets

uiPrinciples.actions: One visible action per purpose; Open YouTube lives in the shared header.
uiPrinciples.copy: Use concise labels and useful instructions; omit decorative narration and repeated medium labels.
uiPrinciples.metadata: Metadata descriptions are separate from displayed copy; display a description once.
uiPrinciples.hierarchy: Prioritize content and actions; channel artwork is a compact heading avatar.
uiPrinciples.mobileNavigation: Segmented choices and tabs fill the available width with equal flex growth; primary phone navigation uses equal columns.
uiPrinciples.settings: Connection and enabled statuses sit inline beside section headings; passkey removal stays aligned with its credential row.
uiPrinciples.notifications: Sonner renders dark, typed notifications at the bottom right, above phone navigation, with six-second lifetimes (ten for errors), built-in hover and hidden-document pausing, swipe dismissal and keyboard access. Playback notices use the same toaster, including in fullscreen.
uiPrinciples.scroll: In-place source and settings filters preserve scroll; route navigation and browser history retain router scroll restoration.
uiPrinciples.playback: Playback uses a flush black viewport with compact black controls.
